auditor_sam: Hi team  SOC2/ISO evidence request. We detected an RBAC change (rolebinding rb-999) during CVE-2026-0606 triage on 2026-07-20. Need: raw CloudTrail KMS events showing no external key export, envelope HMAC/proof if available, concise rollback note, remediation PR + deploy IDs, and whether any CMK policy modifications occurred in the window (2026-07-20T10:00Z-11:00Z). Please provide presigned paths.

emily-sec: Thanks. We'll prepare raw CloudTrail JSON + SIEM correlation and an envelope-proof HMAC. Quick Q  prefer raw events only or raw + signed manifest?

auditor_sam: Raw CloudTrail + HMAC preferred. Manifest ok as supplement.

marc-sre: Uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-evidence/1865432109/rb-999/
- cloudtrail_kms_rb-999.json.gz
- siem_rbac_alerts_rb-999.log.gz
- rb-999-rollback-note.txt
- cve-0606-fix.md
- manifest.sha256.sig
- kms-envelope-hmac.b64

maya-eng: Rollback note (one line): "Reverted rolebinding rb-999 at 2026-07-20T10:18:42Z by maya-eng via ops-runbook v3.6 after canary detected widened admin scope; post-revert canary green at 10:24Z. Ticket: SEC-6117."

emily-sec: CloudTrail excerpt (snippet):
```
{
  "eventTime": "2026-07-20T10:12:05Z",
  "eventName": "GenerateDataKey",
  "userIdentity": { "type": "AssumedRole", "arn": "arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-rbac-agent/agent-9" },
  "requestParameters": { "keyId": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/cc11-dd22" },
  "responseElements": { "ciphertextBlob": "..." }
}
```

emily-sec: HSM/Envelope note: kms-envelope-hmac.b64 contains base64 HMAC + signer id ck-31; verification OK.

marc-sre: CMK policy events: no PutKeyPolicy, DisableKey, ScheduleKeyDeletion, or UpdateKeyDescription for key cc11-dd22 between 2026-07-20T09:45Z and 2026-07-20T11:15Z. There is an unrelated policy change on 2026-06-01.

evidence-bot: Automated check: manifest.sha256.sig signature verified with compliance key ck-17; hashes match uploaded files. :white_check_mark:

auditor_sam: Great  please append a one-line mapping in manifest tying these artifacts to CC6.2 and ISO A.9.2 (detection + remediation evidence). I'll attach to SOC2 packet.

maya-eng: Added mapping lines to manifest-signed.txt: "CC6.2: RBAC change + rollback + KMS/HSM logs demonstrate detection and timely remediation; no key export observed." "ISO A.9.2: Emergency access/rights adjustment performed and verified; HSM wrap/envelope logs show local wrap only."

auditor_sam: Thanks everyone. If the auditor team needs signed HSM attestations I'll request separately. :thumbsup:
